dhak: Any member of the species Butea monosperma of trees of southern Asia.
dharma: The natural order of the universe; natural law, cosmic order.
dhobi: A laundryman or washerman, or laundrywoman or washerwoman.
dhole: An Asian wild dog, Cuon alpinus.
dhooly: Alternative form of dooly (“basic Indian litter; stretcher; litter”).
dhoti: A long loincloth worn by men in India.
dhow: A traditional sailing vessel used along the coasts of Arabia, East Africa, and the Indian Ocean, generally having a single mast and a lateen sail.
dhurrie: A thick, flat-woven cotton Indian rug or carpet.
